description: Header file defining the CmduClientImpl class, which implements a CMDU client for sending and receiving CMDU messages over a socket connection, including handling socket events, buffering, and connection management.

classes.name: CmduClientImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a CMDU client that manages socket communication, message parsing, and event handling for CMDU messages.

methods.name: CmduClientImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CMDU client with connection, parser, serializer, and event loop.

methods.name: ~CmduClientImpl
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the CMDU client instance.

methods.name: send_cmdu
methods.description: Sends a CMDU message to the connected server.

methods.name: forward_cmdu
methods.description: Forwards a received CMDU message to the server.

methods.name: get_fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the socket connection.

methods.name: handle_read
methods.description: Handles socket read events, parsing incoming CMDU messages.

methods.name: close_connection
methods.description: Closes the socket connection and optionally removes event handlers.
